subject: english
prompt: 中翻英：如果明天放晴，班上就會到河岸散步。

options.text: If it will be sunny tomorrow, the class walks by the river.
If sunny tomorrow, the class will walks by the river.
The class if it is sunny tomorrow will taking a walk by the river.
If it is sunny tomorrow, the class will take a walk by the river.

answer.explanation: A likely future condition uses present tense after if and will plus the base verb in the result clause. Take a walk naturally expresses 散步, and by the river gives the route location.

solutionStrategy: 把句子拆成 if 條件和將來結果；if 子句用現在式，主句用 will＋原形動詞。
solutionSteps: 找出條件「如果明天放晴」及結果「班上會散步」。
if 子句使用 it is sunny tomorrow，不在 if 後放 will。
結果句以 the class will 開頭，will 後接原形 take。
用 take a walk 表達散步，by the river 表示河岸路線。
選 D；其餘選項把 will 放錯子句、動詞加錯形式或漏掉必要主詞。
